title: The SQL workbench reports what a datasource connects to (database product, catalog, default schema, credential-free URL) and lists the default schema's tables read-only

criteria.given: a logged-in ROLE_SQL_EXEC/ROLE_ADMIN caller on a default install (FoodMart demo seeded)
criteria.then: GET /rest/saiku/sql-workbench/datasources/foodmart/info reports the database product, driver, catalog and default schema from DatabaseMetaData, and the JDBC URL it reports carries no credential (cf. #2547)

GET /rest/saiku/sql-workbench/datasources/foodmart/tables lists the datasource's default schema tables read-only (the FoodMart H2 seed contains PUBLIC."account"); a datasource name the caller is not entitled to is refused 400 UNKNOWN_DATASOURCE, never a distinguishable exists-but-denied

steps.name: the datasource info names the database product and default catalog/schema, and its URL carries no credential

url.because: the URL is shown to help identify the target, but a password property or URL userinfo must never survive redaction (cf. #2547)

steps.name: the table list names the seeded FoodMart tables read-only

$.because: contains works only on an array, so this also proves the shape; the FoodMart H2 seed creates PUBLIC."account"

steps.name: a datasource the caller is not entitled to is reported as unknown, not denied
